moments.title: F1 Singapore Grand Prix Upcoming
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 season continues this week with practice and qualifying for the Singapore Grand Prix (October 9-11), leading to the main race on Sunday.

angles.name: Race Build-up
angles.copy: Get ready for the F1 Singapore Grand Prix! Practice and qualifying kick off this weekend before the main race on Sunday. Who's your money on for the win? #F1

moments.title: Taylor Swift's UK Chart Double
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift has achieved a UK chart double, with 'Patient Zero' hitting #1 on the Official Singles Chart and 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore' returning to #1 on the Official Albums Chart, as of October 2nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen Reigns
angles.copy: She's done it again! Taylor Swift dominates the UK charts with 'Patient Zero' at #1 on singles and 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore' topping albums. What's your favourite track from the new deluxe edition?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Continues
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off continues with new episodes every Tuesday on Channel 4, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson alongside Paul Hollywood, and hosts Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding.

angles.name: Bake Off Week
angles.copy: Preheat your ovens! The Great British Bake Off is back on Tuesday. Who are you rooting for in the tent this week, and what bakes are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Strictly Live Shows & Icons Week
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing continues its live shows every Saturday on BBC One, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe, and the next themed week, 'Icons Week', approaching on October 17th.

angles.name: Strictly Saturday
angles.copy: Did you catch Strictly last night? The competition is heating up, and we're already looking forward to 'Icons Week' on October 17th!

moments.title: Lewis Capaldi Turns 30
moments.blurb: Scottish singer-songwriter Lewis Capaldi, known for hits like 'Someone You Loved,' celebrates his 30th birthday on October 7th.

angles.name: Happy 30th Lewis!
angles.copy: Happy 30th Birthday to the incredible Lewis Capaldi on Wednesday! What's your favourite track from the Scottish superstar?

moments.title: Thom Yorke's 58th Birthday
moments.blurb: Radiohead frontman and alternative rock pioneer Thom Yorke celebrates his 58th birthday on October 7th.

angles.name: Radiohead Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 58th Birthday to the iconic Thom Yorke from Radiohead on Wednesday! What's your ultimate Radiohead anthem?

moments.title: Toni Braxton Turns 59
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning R&B superstar Toni Braxton, known for hits like 'Un-Break My Heart,' celebrates her 59th birthday on October 7th.

angles.name: R&B Diva Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the incredible Toni Braxton this Wednesday! Time to get 'Un-Break My Heart' on repeat!

moments.title: John Mellencamp Turns 75
moments.blurb: American rock icon John Mellencamp, famous for classics like 'Jack & Diane' and 'Hurts So Good,' celebrates his 75th birthday on October 7th.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary John Mellencamp on Wednesday! What's your favourite track from the 'Indiana Wants Me' singer?

moments.title: Bon Jovi's Tico Torres Turns 73
moments.blurb: Tico Torres, the powerhouse drummer for rock legends Bon Jovi, celebrates his 73rd birthday on October 7th.

angles.name: Bon Jovi Drummer
angles.copy: Happy 73rd Birthday to Bon Jovi's incredible drummer, Tico Torres, this Wednesday! What's your go-to Bon Jovi anthem?

moments.title: Glastonbury 2027 Ticket Registration Open
moments.blurb: With Glastonbury taking a fallow year in 2026, ticket registration for the 2027 festival is now open, with general sales expected in October/November.

angles.name: Glasto Buzz
angles.copy: No Glastonbury in 2026, but the excitement for 2027 is real! Ticket registration is open now, with sales expected soon. Will you be trying for tickets?

moments.title: Keo Debut Album Hits #2
moments.blurb: British grunge-rockers Keo have debuted at number 2 on the Official Albums Chart with their new album 'Put a Smile on Me.'

angles.name: New Rock Talent
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Keo! Their debut album 'Put a Smile on Me' has stormed into the Official Albums Chart at #2. Have you heard it yet?

moments.title: Cardiff Half Marathon Today
moments.blurb: Thousands of runners took to the streets of the Welsh capital today, Sunday, October 4th, for the annual Cardiff Half Marathon.

angles.name: Race Day in Cardiff
angles.copy: Massive well done to everyone who ran the Cardiff Half Marathon today! What an atmosphere in the city. Tag a runner you know!

moments.title: Little Shop of Horrors in Exeter
moments.blurb: The acclaimed musical 'Little Shop of Horrors' is currently running at Exeter Northcott Theatre from October 4th to 17th.

angles.name: Musical Theatre in Devon
angles.copy: Looking for some live entertainment in Exeter? 'Little Shop of Horrors' is now showing at the Northcott Theatre until October 17th!

moments.title: Autumn & Halloween Season
moments.blurb: October is in full swing, with pumpkin patches open across the UK and many preparing for Halloween events and various autumn festivals.

angles.name: Autumn Vibes
angles.copy: Crisp air, changing leaves, and pumpkin spice everything! October is here, and we're getting into the full swing of autumn. What are your favourite seasonal traditions?
